subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class III

source.read: Directorate of Education, Delhi: Class III English annual syllabus 2026-27, built on the NCERT textbook Santoor (NCF-SE 2023) that CBSE schools use
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. CBSE does not publish a line-by-line English syllabus below Class 9; this list follows a state education department's year plan for the NCERT book Santoor, read through a text summary of the PDF. Chapters are named by kind, not reproduced.

outcomes.text: Uses full stops and question marks.
Uses naming words, one and many, action words and describing words.
Uses pronouns, in, on and under, and here and there.
Uses a, an and the, and is or are to match one or many.
Joins ideas with and and but.
Uses opposites such as thick and thin, long and short.
